text_block_list.text: All right! Watch and learn! HYAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Whew! And that's how you make it nice
and fluffy!
Now, when you yell, it's
important to—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Um, is the screaming really necessary?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Of course it is! Everything requires
passion!
C'mon, City! Use that
diaphragm and let it really
rip!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Omelet training! City's gonna be on a
cooking
show!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
As soon as I told Bamboo about it, she
insisted on
helping me.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Well, I was fired up! And who wouldn't
be after
hearing why you agreed to the
show even though
you can't cook?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
H-hey! There's no need to go into
details!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Watching you trying your best at
modeling and
racing all the time is what
inspires your fans. I
know you don't want
to let them down!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
You agreed to go on the show just so
they could
see you trying your best at
something that's hard
for you!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Well, the support of my fans is what
motivates
me. I can't always be on the
receiving end.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! What heat! What fiery passion!
City, your
heart is like a furnace, and I'm
gonna do all I can
to help you keep it
burning!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
What am I still standing here for?! I'll be
back in a
sec, so don't you move!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Thanks for waiting!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Oh, not again... Don't tell me you—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's right! I did some quick waterfall
training to
power myself up to support
you!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Now, behold my newly evolved
omelet-making
skills!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hryaaah!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Don't you blink, now! Here comes the
great,
never-ending... OMELET
INFINITY!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: RAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Order up!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
City! I hereby bestow this cooking
technique to
you!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Where do I even start with this?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Where do I even start with this?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I guess I can buy that. I just have to
keep
trying until I can do it.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
And I'll be here at your side! ...And don't
you go
anywhere either, Trainer! I'm
gonna need a taste
tester!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I stick around for Bamboo Memory's rather intense cooking lesson as she tasks me with tasting each omelet... and washing the dishes... and getting more eggs.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Not you too... You're on board with this?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Wooooo! Things're heatin' up now! I can
almost
smell the burning passion in the—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whoosh...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oh craaap! I left the burner on!
